content: When the current state is LINSM_FULL_COM , the LinIf_GotoSleep returns E_OK and the requested commu nication mode by ComM module is COMM_NO _COMMUNICATION , the ComM shall be notified of the bus sleep event by calling ComM_BusSM_BusSleepMode for the specified network .

When the current state is LINSM_FULL_COM , the LinIf_GotoSleep returns E_OK and the requested commu nication mode by ComM module is COMM_NO _COMMUNICATION , the ComM shall be notified of the bus sleep event by calling ComM_BusSM_BusSleepMode for the specified network .

When the current state is LINSM_FULL_COM, and the requested communication mode by ComM module is CO MM_NO_COMMUNICATION, LinIf shall call LinIf_GotoSleep and afterwards notifiy ComM of the bus sleep event by calling ComM_BusSM_BusSleepMode for the specified network .

When the current state is LINSM_FULL_COM, and the re- quested communication mode by ComM module is COMM_NO_COMMUNICATION, LinIf shall call LinIf_GotoSleep and afterwards notifiy ComM of the bus sleep event by calling ComM_BusSM_BusSleepMode for the specified network.
